title: City Gardens
text: Cities can become greener when people plant trees, protect parks, and use public transportation. In many neighborhoods, empty spaces are being changed into small community gardens. Residents grow tomatoes, herbs, and flowers there. They also meet their neighbors and learn how to care for plants. These gardens make the air cleaner and give people a quiet place to rest. Trees provide shade during hot days, while flowers attract bees and butterflies. Public transportation is another important part of a greener city. When people take a bus or ride a bicycle, fewer cars are on the road, reducing noise and pollution. A green city grows through small choices made by many people.

title: Life in the Ocean
text: The ocean is home to many different animals. Near the surface, small fish eat tiny plants called algae. Larger fish eat the smaller fish, so every animal has a role in the food chain. Coral reefs are another important home. They give young fish places to hide and provide food for many sea creatures. However, plastic waste can hurt animals when they mistake it for food. People can protect ocean life by using fewer plastic bags, keeping beaches clean, and respecting animals in their natural homes. Small actions on land can help keep the water healthy.
